assertions: Each supported text format exports deterministically.
Each exported golden record imports without quarantine and preserves title, authors, year, DOI, PMID and container title.
An unterminated PubMed XML article is quarantined with its exact source line range.
Attributed PubMed abstract sections and inline title markup are preserved as normalized bibliographic text.
Parenthesized BibTeX entries are imported, while unterminated BibTeX and EndNote records are quarantined with source line ranges.
Multiple compact EndNote records and multiple same-line BibTeX entries are imported without silent loss; delimiters inside BibTeX field values do not terminate entries.
limitations: Parquet and named custom formats remain explicitly unsupported by the text interchange runtime and are not included.
Semantic completeness beyond the asserted canonical fields is not claimed.
This receipt contains no repository-owner decision on the agent-panel deduplication and study-linkage evaluation.
